name: Whiterock
location: Limestone shelves, half-day east of former stronger den

defenses: Reinforced gate with two watch posts
caves: Main cave: sleeping ledges, stone-lined fire pit, storage alcoves with shelves, barrable timber door
Secondary cave: cleared, doored, suitable for private quarters or additional storage
agricultureAndAnimals: Expanded garden plots with first seeds planted
Two pens (one finished, one started) ready for goats/pigs

population.rules: Women protected. Breeding controlled by Azra. Obedience in exchange for safety, food, water, work, and trust.

notes: Built in approximately two weeks of intensive labor. Ready for further expansion and additional residents who accept the rules. Elena has not yet visited.
